basic_info.description: Welcome to 1921-1923 Jackson Street, a stunning two unit building with San Francsico charm and elegant 1939 Art Deco architecture. Located in Pacific Heights in one of the most prestigious San Francisco neighborhoods, on the same city block as the Spreckels Mansion and 2006 Washington Street.    Step into the gated entry where a terrazzo staircase leads you to the vacant, first-floor apartment. Inside, you'll find a double wide living room featuring high ceilings, large corner windows, and a gorgeous fireplace. From the dining room, you'll notice light spilling in from an interior patio, which serves as a central source of natural light. The kitchen is thoughtfully designed and is connected to a separate breakfast room. Down the hall are the powder room and a full bath with original tilework. At the back of the apartment are two spacious bedrooms. And finally, step out onto the expansive wooden deck, which is nestled against a terraced garden complete with enchanting stonework and lush vegetation.    On the top floor, you'll find a charming, occupied flat, which includes a bedroom, living room, dining room, bathroom, and kitchen that leads outside onto its own private deck space. The garage has 2 car independent parking. Lafayette Park is just a block away. Walk score of 94!
